# authwise_factor_webauthn (Data Source)

Builds a FactorWebAuthn config and exposes its google.protobuf.Any encoding as `any`. Makes no API calls.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `allowed_origins` (List of String)
- `attestation` (String)
- `authenticator_attachment` (String)
- `hints` (List of String)
- `resident_key` (String)
- `rp_display_name` (String)
- `rp_id` (String)
- `user_verification` (String)

### Read-Only

- `any` (String) protojson-encoded google.protobuf.Any (includes `@type`); reference this from Any-typed resource attributes.
